Alice — attaching the sample artifacts and short controls narrative below. Please note we redacted personal identifiers per our data handling guidance; mapping can be provided under an NDA escalation if needed.

Attachments included in Drive upload:
- praxis_scim_delta_sample.csv (7-day delta, pseudonymized id)
- praxis_saml_assertions.txt (3 assertion examples: interactive, idp-initiated, service-account)
- access_ownership_matrix_v1.xlsx (role -> permission mapping + owners)
- svcacct_rotation_log_90days.csv (rotation events for named service accounts, masked keys)

Controls summary (short):
- Service accounts: owned by platform team; keys rotated every 30 days via automated job; rotation log is centrally recorded and immutable.
- RBAC review: role definitions owned by Product Security; quarterly review cadence; ad-hoc reviews on org changes.
- MFA boundary: human accounts require MFA for interactive auth; service accounts are not MFA-bound but are limited by network ACLs and short-lived keys.

Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcd_EvidenceDrop (view-only; upload enabled for redwood-internal)

ETA: We uploaded the initial package at 15:00 PST. Let us know if you need raw assertion XML instead of the redacted/annotated samples.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

Redwood Inference
